ops.body: SUPERSEDED — not completable against its criteria, which pin the retired stable-path mechanism (a kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData row keyed to /Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/bin/cc-pool). That whole path-keyed re-exec approach is deleted as of cc-pool v0.59.0 (tag bd55a87b): the daemon now ships as CCPoolDaemon.app (bundle id com.yasyf.cc-pool.daemon + embedded Developer ID profile authorizing SXKCTF23Q2.*, which covers SXKCTF23Q2.ccp), so tccd keys the grant to the bundle identifier (client_type=0), durable across upgrades — no path-keyed row exists anymore. The two-upgrade proof this task wanted now runs on the NEW model via runbook b03f9f95 ("Live TCC durable-identity validation"), which asserts a client_type=0 bundle row surviving a second consecutive upgrade with zero prompts. Root-cause history: the stable-path fix could never work because macOS fallback consent is instance-scoped (see note ed5a74dc + the design in the approve-the-group-container plan). Canceling; the live proof is tracked by the runbook.
